entities.summary: Razi University is a public university based in Kermanshah, Iran. The school's Science and Engineering Departments attract many Iranian high school graduates as well as many graduate school applicants from all over Iran with a majority admitted from western provinces. Razi University is a university in Asia, established in 1972. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
